import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features for driver selection
    non_derived_ids = [fid for fid, typ in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if typ != 'derived']
    non_derived_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in non_derived_ids]
    
    # Calculate effect sizes using mean difference
    means_y1 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 1][:, non_derived_indices], axis=0)
    means_y0 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 0][:, non_derived_indices], axis=0)
    effect_sizes = np.abs(means_y1 - means_y0)
    
    # Rank features by effect size
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1]
    top_features = [non_derived_ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Check for correlation to avoid near-duplicates
    selected = []
    for fid in top_features:
        if not selected:
            selected.append(fid)
        else:
            # Check correlation with already selected features
            col_idx = feats.column(fid)
            is_correlated = False
            for sel_fid in selected:
                sel_col = feats.column(sel_fid)
                corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col_idx], feats.x[:, sel_col])[0, 1]
                if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                    is_correlated = True
                    break
            if not is_correlated:
                selected.append(fid)
    
    # Select columns for regression (all non-derived)
    columns = tuple(non_derived_ids)
    
    # Build products from top features
    products = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(selected):
        for fid2 in selected[i+1:]:
            products.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Loadings: weights based on effect size
    loadings = {}
    for fid in selected:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        loadings[fid] = float(effect_sizes[sorted_indices[list(non_derived_ids).index(fid)]])
    
    # Simplify to ensure small model
    if len(selected) > 1:
        # Use only main effects to reduce terms
        columns = tuple(selected)
        products = ()
    elif len(selected) == 1:
        # Single driver
        columns = tuple(selected)
        products = ()
    else:
        # No drivers
        columns = ()
        products = ()
        loadings = {}
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(selected),
        columns=columns,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
